BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the judicial conduct commission; and amendingRCW 2.64.020.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 2.64.020 and 2005 c 15 s 1 are each amended to read asfollows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The commission shall consist of ((eleven)) fourteen members.((One)) Two members shall be ((a)) judges selected by and from thecourt of appeals judges; ((one)) two members shall be ((a)) judgesselected by and from the superior court judges; ((one)) two membersshall be ((a)) judges selected by and from the limited jurisdictioncourt judges; two members shall be selected by the state barassociation and be admitted to the practice of law in this state; andsix members shall be nonlawyers appointed by the governor. The term ofeach member of the commission shall be four years. (2) No commission member or alternate who participates in aninvestigation or initial proceeding leading to a finding of probablecause may participate in any further proceedings on that cause, p. 1 SB 5115including a public hearing.
